indexStudy.notes: One isolated Chrome 1M import per index strategy. Source-route substitution only. Each trial includes durable writes and current full validation. Heap is WASM allocation, not browser RSS.

notes: Benchmarks are one trial per size, not medians. Final imports/exports/restores were sequential.
Small browser correctness/recovery checks ran briefly alongside the initial part of the final 1M trial; no competing large benchmarks or builds ran.
WASM byte lengths are allocated linear memory, not browser RSS or JavaScript peak memory.
The source-browser harness report-label ordering was corrected after these runs; assertions and runtime modules were unchanged.
Final recovery used the 6.38 MB --small interruption fixture; earlier 93.65 MB interruption coverage also passed.
Native folder-picker permissions, physical disk-full/power-loss and full embedded-browser restart remain unqualified.
